title: System Reset: Being Unreasonable and Unambiguous
coreMove: Dreamlining resets ambition by turning have, be, and do wishes into dated targets, monthly costs, and first physical actions.

exampleSpecs.stakes: turn a travel wish into a dated and priced project
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the Dreamline worksheet to convert a vague wish into six-month numbers and a first step.

exampleSpecs.audience: people who confuse gear with the life they want
exampleSpecs.stakes: separate possessions from skill and lived experience
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show why have, be, and do belong in separate dreamline categories.

exampleSpecs.audience: self-improvers stuck in vague study habits
exampleSpecs.stakes: replace a lifelong label with an observable language target
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the 15-minute conversation with a native speaker as the performance test.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers assuming lifestyle needs an impressive salary
exampleSpecs.stakes: calculate target monthly income from priced dreams instead of status
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Reveal that target monthly income comes from the dreamline's actual monthly costs.

exampleSpecs.audience: professionals trimming goals until they feel respectable
exampleSpecs.stakes: decide whether an unusual dream deserves a real plan
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show that large goals can be strategic when they are still priced, dated, and stepped.

exampleSpecs.audience: planners who keep refining the worksheet
exampleSpecs.stakes: prevent dreamlining from becoming private entertainment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the immediate first action to stop planning from becoming avoidance.
